overview: The Medford License Commission met for an unscheduled August session to hear a compliance violation by Blue Fuji, approve several one-day liquor licenses, accept a license surrender, and review progress for the Great American Beer Hall.

items.title: Minutes of the July Meeting
items.summary: Voted to waive review of the July 17 meeting minutes until the September meeting.

items.title: Compliance Hearing: Blue Fuji
items.summary: Following testimony on a June 20 compliance check where alcohol was served to minors, the commission issued a one-day suspension held in abeyance for one year and ordered all current employees to obtain TIPS certification within 90 days.

items.title: One-Day License: Cuisine en Locale
items.summary: Approved a one-day license for a performance showcase event on August 22 at 344 Salem Street.

items.title: One-Day License: Medford Chamber of Commerce Event
items.summary: Approved a one-day license for a September 14 community food and music event in the municipal lot behind 465 High Street, conditional on receiving an updated application.

items.title: One-Day Licenses: D1 Soccer
items.summary: Approved one-day licenses for events at Hormel Stadium on August 25 and September 15, and voted to reschedule an earlier approved August 31 license to September 8.

items.title: License Surrender: Qdoba
items.summary: Approved the surrender of the liquor and entertainment licenses previously held by Qdoba.

items.title: Great American Beer Hall Status Update
items.summary: Approved allowing Great American Beer Hall to proceed with service once all outstanding city inspection checkmarks, common victualler approvals, and final occupancy certifications are submitted.

items.title: One-Day License: Life Time Medford
items.summary: Approved a one-day license for an August 22 member social event at 70 Station Landing.

items.title: One-Day License: Deep Cuts
items.summary: Tabled the one-day license application to the September 18 meeting due to application errors regarding event date, location, and absence of an event sketch.
